findings.title: Floor area differs across documents
findings.summary: EXPOSE (listing) states 105 m²; FLOOR_PLAN (plan) states 92 m². The difference is 13 m²; the applicable measurement basis needs verification.
findings.buyer_action: Ask which floor-area figure is legally recognised and request supporting documentation and measurements.

findings.title: Documented upcoming works contribution
findings.summary: Supplied evidence documents a €6,500.00 planned works contribution attributable to the unit. Responsibility for payment needs verification.

evidence.excerpt: Upcoming roof works: contribution for this unit is €6,500.

findings.buyer_action: Ask who is responsible for payment—the current owner or the purchaser—and request the payment schedule.

findings.title: Supporting planning documentation not supplied
findings.summary: The supplied facts describe an existing alteration or extension and explicitly state that supporting planning/compliance documentation was not supplied. Status is unknown and needs verification; the absence of documents does not establish non-compliance.

evidence.excerpt: Planning permission documentation for the rear extension was not supplied.

findings.buyer_action: Request the relevant planning permission and compliance documentation for the alteration or extension and verify it before proceeding.

financial_impacts.description: Documented additional unit contribution; purchaser liability and payment status require confirmation. Do not sum separate contributions until event identity and revisions are reconciled.
